scalars.scalar_value: Have a bachelor’s degree from an accredited institution completed by time of hire.
Three years of experience, including two years in a lead or supervisory capacity, as a law enforcement officer.

items.item_text: Currently possesses the California Commission on Peace Officer Standards and Training (POST) Advanced Certificate.
Completion of the requirements (psychological and medical examinations, background investigation, etc.) for appropriate POST certification.
Have a bachelor’s degree from an accredited institution completed by time of hire.
Three years of experience, including two years in a lead or supervisory capacity, as a law enforcement officer.
Complete California POST Supervisory course within one year of hire.

Have an equity-minded focus, responsiveness, and sensitivity to and understanding of the diverse academic, socioeconomic, cultural, disability, gender identity, sexual orientation, and ethnic backgrounds of community college students, including those with physical or learning disabilities as it relates to differences in learning styles; and successfully foster and support an inclusive educational and employment environment.
